subject: general
question: Which of the following witness types is formally recognized in the BSA, 2023?

options.text: Expert witnesses such as forensic analysts

solution: The correct answer is __**Expert witnesses such as forensic analysts**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Expert witnesses** are individuals with specialized knowledge, skills, or expertise in a particular field relevant to a legal case. They are formally recognized under the **BSA (Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam), 2023**. • The role of expert witnesses includes providing technical, scientific, or professional opinions to help the court understand complex evidence or facts. • Fields of expertise commonly considered include **forensics, medicine, ballistics, engineering, accounting, and digital forensics**. • The **BSA, 2023** highlights the importance of expert opinions in cases involving **scientific analysis, forensic evidence, and technical data**. • Unlike lay witnesses, expert witnesses are allowed to offer opinions based on their expertise rather than limiting their testimony to factual observations. This makes their input critical in modern legal proceedings.
